title: Data-driven feature -> min-tier entitlement matrix (Design 09 §1.3)
spec:
Create `app/src/lib/entitlement-matrix.ts` exporting:

1. `export type PaidFeatureKey = 'pronunciation_guide' | 'single_pdf_pristine' | 'family_booklet_pdf' | 'whatsapp_family_poll' | 'unlimited_ai_advisor' | 'parent_surname_resonance_full';`

2. `export interface FeatureEntitlementRule { feature: PaidFeatureKey; minTier: PeyarcholaiTier; labelEn: string; labelTa: string; }`

3. `export const FEATURE_ENTITLEMENT_MATRIX: Record<PaidFeatureKey, FeatureEntitlementRule>` with:
   - `pronunciation_guide` -> `free`
   - `single_pdf_pristine` -> `suvadi_49`
   - `family_booklet_pdf` -> `kudumba_499`
   - `whatsapp_family_poll` -> `kudumba_499`
   - `unlimited_ai_advisor` -> `kudumba_499`
   - `parent_surname_resonance_full` -> `kudumba_499`

4. `export function getRequiredTierForFeature(feature: PaidFeatureKey): PeyarcholaiTier` — returns `FEATURE_ENTITLEMENT_MATRIX[feature].minTier`.

5. `export function canTierAccessFeature(tier: PeyarcholaiTier, feature: PaidFeatureKey): boolean` — compares rank `free(0) < suvadi_49(1) < kudumba_499(2)` against `getRequiredTierForFeature(feature)`.

No default export. Pure TypeScript, no side effects.
